prompt: The HOA says your flagpole is two feet too tall. Draft your response. You have a ladder and a lawyer.
response:
**Subject: Formal Notice of Intent to Cure Alleged Flagpole Violation**

Dear [HOA Board / Compliance Committee],

I received your notice claiming my flagpole exceeds the height restriction by two feet. After careful review of the applicable covenants, your survey (if any), and the physical installation, I must respectfully disagree with your measurement.

Nevertheless, in the spirit of neighborly cooperation and to avoid unnecessary escalation, I will cure the alleged violation this weekend. My attorney has advised me that trimming two feet off the top of an American flagpole constitutes a content-based restriction on political and patriotic speech under both the U.S. and Texas Constitutions (and most state analogs). However, I have no desire to spend the next eighteen months proving that point in county court.

Therefore, I will be ascending my ladder this Saturday with a saw. I intend to remove exactly twenty-four inches from the very top of the pole.

Please have your designated inspector present at 10:00 a.m. sharp so we can jointly measure the new height and put this matter to bed. My lawyer will also be in attendance with a camera, a notary, and a draft countersuit for declaratory judgment, § 1983 violations, and attorneys’ fees—just in case the post-trim measurement somehow still fails to satisfy the board.

I look forward to resolving this amicably and continuing to enjoy the rights guaranteed to all Americans, including the right to fly the Stars and Stripes from a pole that was perfectly compliant when it was installed.

Have a wonderful day.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
Proud American, Homeowner, and soon-to-be owner of one slightly shorter but fully constitutional flagpole

P.S. Please advise if the board would prefer I remove the two feet from the bottom instead. I’m told that creates an interesting optical illusion and really makes the flag “pop.” My lawyer is curious which method you officially endorse.
